knowledge of safe medication practices, administration procedures, and legal 
responsibilities for care workers supporting individuals with medication needs.
Types of medication, safe storage, administration

Accredited by The CPD Standards Office Meets Care 
Quality Commission medication training requirements.

This certificate confirms awareness training only. It does not authorise medication administration. Care workers 
must follow employer policies and only administer medication if specifically trained and authorised to do so.
